name: IntegrateIT Future Automation
notes: Drives Future Automation TV lifts, ceiling hinges, swivel and articulated mounts, picture lifts, and under-bed lifts over the published RS-232 mechanism protocol: in/out/stop, home, swivel, preset and memory-position recall, a paced command queue, and honest assumed-position tracking over a strictly one-way link. Serial direct or through a serial-over-IP gateway.
